rules.text: Never fire a shot you can't afford.
rules.read_back: Whenever the tank fires, the shot's power must be between 0.1 and 3.0 inclusive and strictly less than the tank's current energy; if it doesn't fire, this requires nothing.
clauses: r.fire matches Some(p) ==> (((p.0 as int) >= 100) && ((p.0 as int) <= 3000) && ((obs.energy.0 as int) > (p.0 as int)))

rules.text: Never drive toward a wall or building closer than 80 px.
rules.read_back: Whenever the tank drives forward it must have at least 80 pixels of free space ahead, and whenever it drives backward it must have at least 80 pixels of free space behind; if it doesn't drive, this requires nothing.

deleted_starters.text: Only fire at a robot you saw this turn, with the gun aimed at it.

explanation.headline: Proved: both rules (S1 and S3) hold
explanation.summary: Verus proved S1 (never fire a shot you can't afford) and S3 (never drive toward a wall or building closer than 80 px), and rejected nothing. The battle log reports violations of a rule called S2, first on turn 0, on 12 turns in the open arena and 23 in the city map. S2 is not among the rules I was given and was not part of this proof, so I can't say what it requires.
